parts.text: Hello, my name is Pedro. I’m a UX Product Designer focused on
creating meaningful digital experiences that add real value.
I work closely with cross-functional teams to
bring products to life—from concept to launch
—through design principles, prototyping, and usability testing. I thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy transforming complex challenges into intuitive, user-centered solutions.
Experienced in projects across finance, banking, insurance, pharmaceuticals, government, and e-commerce, I’ve led end-to-end design proceses—from
research and wireframing to high-fidelity prototyping
and product rollout. I collaborate with agile, multidisciplinary teams and embrace new challenges that push me to learn and innovate.
